name: The oeuvre on one line
inputs: the packet's texts (uid, year, title, side)
shape: The author's texts as ticks on one horizontal line by year, each coloured by the agenda whose span holds it, the focal text as a larger marked tick, the turns as labelled vertical cuts between the two texts that show them; hover or a legend names the agendas; the out-of-scope and unprofiled texts as hollow ticks.
didactic: In one glance: how long each agenda runs, where the focal text sits among them, and where the oeuvre turns.
example: Brenner 1985: six agendas 1972–2025, five turns, the focal text in the transition agenda's middle.

evidence.note: each agenda's lane description is cut off mid-sentence, so the "glance" the exhibit promises does not deliver a complete claim
truncated labels contradict the exhibit's own no-truncation aim
